<div id="share-form-view">

I'd love to hear how the course is going for you — what's working, what's confusing, what you'd change. It takes a couple of minutes, and every response helps me improve this web edition for the people coming after you.

If you're willing to be quoted, there's a spot on the form to say so — anonymously or with your name and role — but that's entirely optional. Anything you share is otherwise just for me.
